commit.subject: LU-20428 lod: init fld range type before lod_fld_lookup
commit.message:
LU-20428 lod: init fld range type before lod_fld_lookup

Initialize fld range type to LU_SEQ_RANGE_MDT properly in
lod_dir_layout_check() before calling lod_fld_lookup() to
avoid passing any garbage into fld_range_set_type().

Test-Parameters: fstype=zfs mdtcount=4 mdscount=2 testlist=sanity env=ONLY=230k,ONLY_REPEAT=100
Test-Parameters: fstype=ldiskfs mdtcount=4 mdscount=2 testlist=sanity env=ONLY=230k,ONLY_REPEAT=100
Fixes: 4b922dec731c ("LU-18869 dne: mdt migrate to check layout")
